question: Provide an overview of your company including ownership structure and financial stability and number of customers in the financial services sector.
Describe your pricing model and standard contract terms including term length and payment terms.
What is your standard limitation of liability and are you willing to negotiate it for a regulated financial institution?
Describe your termination provisions and the assistance you provide on exit including data return and deletion.
Confirm the insurance coverage you hold and provide limits.
Describe the platform architecture including how data is ingested and modelled and served to end users.
Which data sources and connectors are supported out of the box and how are new connectors added?
Describe the multi-tenancy model and the technical controls that isolate our data from other tenants.
Can the platform be hosted exclusively within the EU and can you commit that no data leaves the EU?
Describe the APIs available for integration with our existing data warehouse and reporting tools.
Does the platform include AI or natural-language features and how is their use governed?
Which security certifications do you hold and can you provide the reports?
Describe encryption of data at rest and in transit and how encryption keys are managed.
Describe identity and access management including SSO and MFA and role-based access control and audit logging.
Summarise the findings of your most recent penetration test and your vulnerability management SLAs.
What availability SLA do you offer and what remedies apply if it is not met?
Describe your support model including hours of coverage and response times by severity.
What are your disaster recovery objectives and when was disaster recovery last tested?
